spans.text: Mu kibila ti bunzimbu ayi lulenzo lu miswa mi bumutu binnatanga ku phangulu mavanga manbayuwanga ku tsi-ntima bumutu, ayi mu kutala ti ngizulu yi nza yi bumutu bu kakuka mu matuba ayi mu ngwilukulu-zinzambi, ayi bu kakukeso mu themosono batu ayi mu buya-buphasi, yawu iyamukusu ti ngudi-lutia lu woso mutu;

Mu kibila ti mu Pfumu-Mkanda, zitsi zioso zi kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana zinyamikis eso diana ayi kivuvu kiawu mu ngudi-minswa mi bumutu, mu bunswa ayi mu buzitu bu bumutu, mu budedi bu kinswa kitedi kuidi babakala ayi kuidi bakhieto; Ayi mu kutala ti baboso bakikinini kuvanga madi nkinza ayi kunata-ntwala mu luzingu lwawu kimpwanza ki mnene;
Ayi mu dikwela ayi mu mbanusunu dikwela, badi miswa dede.
Woso mutu widi na luve ayi mswa mu kimpwanza ki lubundunu ayi ki thwadi ayi badi-andi, kivimba ndembama ikinzuku.

spans.text: MTINU-LUKUTUNGUNU Wunyamikisa NGYAMUKUSU YI MISWA MI MUTU emimi, dede lukanu lunsadulu kuidi zinvila ayi zitsi zioso, mosi batu boso ayi binvuka biluyalu bi zitsi zioso, bu ba-mi-tebukila monho, basia-ngolo mu-ku-mi-yiyisa mu zinzo-zinkanda, mu-ku-mi-tumina ayi mu-kwe-mi-yonzulanga mu mavanga ma basi tsi-awu ayi mu mavanga ma basi bandi-batu, bakhembo basi kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana.

Batu boso babeki dilwaku di kutatila miswa ayi maluve ma-mayamukusu mu MTINU-NGYAMUKUSU ewiwi, mu kukhambu vengula woso mutu, keti mu matedi phila ndimba mkand andi yi nhitu, evo mu matedi bukhieto evo bubala bwandi, evo mu matedi mbembo andi, evo phila nzambi andi, evo mu matedi phila politikandi, evo phila kingudi kiandi, evo mu kibila kinkaka.
Batu boso badedakana mu mikaka ayi miswa mi luyalu, mu kukhambu swasunu, badi dede mu butanunu va thalu mswa-mtinu.

Tona bankituka ditoko ayi ndumba banhieka, kimbakala ayi kikhieto mswa ayi luve lwawu badi mu kukwela ayi kuvanga dikanda, mu kukambu kanduku mu kibila ki mambu ma-tedi phila ndimba yi mkanda nhitu, evo mu kibila ki mambu matedi luswasunu lu bwisi-tsi, evo mu kibila ki matedi luswasunu lu zingwikukulu-mu-zinzambi.

entries.description: veka evo mu mkangu
entries.subject: veka evo

entries.description: lu kubaluka mu luwiluku evo mu mayindu
entries.subject: lu kubaluka

spans.text: Woso mutu mswa ayi luve kadi ku kimpwanza ki mayindu, ki tsimtima ayi ki luwiluku; Mswa bewowo umvana luve kwidi woso mutu lu kubaluka mu luwiluku evo mu mayindu, na mu mbonosono luwiluku lwandi ayi mayindu mandi, va nafeka evo va mbo-yi-batu, nafeka voti na mbatzi-andi, mu zikhadulu, mu malongi evo mu tsambudulu ayi voti mu phila bipa.

entries.description: tisu mu ngolo kukota mu kithwadi
entries.subject: tisu

spans.text: Kwisi-ko mutu mtisu mu ngolo kukota mu kithwadi.

entries.task_id: bunafeka evo|mu|bumvwala
entries.description: bunafeka evo mu bumvwala
entries.subject: bunafeka evo

spans.text: Woso mutu widi mswa ayi luve lubyalu lu tsi-andi, mu bunafeka evo mu bumvwala.

folded.id: ayi|mu|kutala ti ngizulu yi nza yi bumutu bu kakuka mu matuba ayi mu ngwilukulu-zinzambi
folded.subject: ayi
folded.object: kutala ti ngizulu yi nza yi bumutu bu kakuka mu matuba ayi mu ngwilukulu-zinzambi

spans.text: Mu kibila ti bunzimbu ayi lulenzo lu miswa mi bumutu binnatanga ku phangulu mavanga manbayuwanga ku tsi-ntima bumutu, ayi mu kutala ti ngizulu yi nza yi bumutu bu kakuka mu matuba ayi mu ngwilukulu-zinzambi, ayi bu kakukeso mu themosono batu ayi mu buya-buphasi, yawu iyamukusu ti ngudi-lutia lu woso mutu;

Mu kibila ti mu Pfumu-Mkanda, zitsi zioso zi kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana zinyamikis eso diana ayi kivuvu kiawu mu ngudi-minswa mi bumutu, mu bunswa ayi mu buzitu bu bumutu, mu budedi bu kinswa kitedi kuidi babakala ayi kuidi bakhieto; Ayi mu kutala ti baboso bakikinini kuvanga madi nkinza ayi kunata-ntwala mu luzingu lwawu kimpwanza ki mnene;
Ayi mu dikwela ayi mu mbanusunu dikwela, badi miswa dede.
Woso mutu widi na luve ayi mswa mu kimpwanza ki lubundunu ayi ki thwadi ayi badi-andi, kivimba ndembama ikinzuku.

folded.id: badi dede|mu|butanunu va thalu mswa-mtinu
folded.subject: badi dede

spans.text: Batu boso badedakana mu mikaka ayi miswa mi luyalu, mu kukhambu swasunu, badi dede mu butanunu va thalu mswa-mtinu.

folded.id: badi dede|mu|luve lu kutanunu vadi loso luswasunu lumbayisa nza-ngyamukusu eyiyi ayi vadi mavanga moso ma bundima kuidi ngyamukusu eyiyi
folded.subject: badi dede
folded.object: luve lu kutanunu vadi loso luswasunu lumbayisa NZA-NGYAMUKUSU eyiyi ayi vadi mavanga moso ma bundima kuidi NGYAMUKUSU eyiyi

spans.text: Baboso badi dede mu luve lu kutanunu vadi loso luswasunu lumbayisa NZA-NGYAMUKUSU eyiyi ayi vadi mavanga moso ma bundima kuidi NGYAMUKUSU eyiyi.

Tona bankituka ditoko ayi ndumba banhieka, kimbakala ayi kikhieto mswa ayi luve lwawu badi mu kukwela ayi kuvanga dikanda, mu kukambu kanduku mu kibila ki mambu ma-tedi phila ndimba yi mkanda nhitu, evo mu kibila ki mambu matedi luswasunu lu bwisi-tsi, evo mu kibila ki matedi luswasunu lu zingwikukulu-mu-zinzambi.

folded.id: batu bambutukanga|mu|kidedi ki buzitu ayi kibumswa
folded.subject: batu bambutukanga

spans.text: Bizingi bioso bisiwu ti batu bambutukanga mu kidedi ki buzitu ayi kibumswa.

spans.text: Batu boso badi na mswa u-lenda ku-ba-zitusu mu mambu moso matedi bunhitu-mswa bwawu.

folded.subject: bunafeka evo

spans.text: Woso mutu widi mswa ayi luve lubyalu lu tsi-andi, mu bunafeka evo mu bumvwala.

folded.id: eso|mu|themosono batu ayi mu buya-buphasi
folded.subject: eso

folded.id: evo|mu|kibila kinkaka
folded.subject: evo

spans.text: Batu boso babeki dilwaku di kutatila miswa ayi maluve ma-mayamukusu mu MTINU-NGYAMUKUSU ewiwi, mu kukhambu vengula woso mutu, keti mu matedi phila ndimba mkand andi yi nhitu, evo mu matedi bukhieto evo bubala bwandi, evo mu matedi mbembo andi, evo phila nzambi andi, evo mu matedi phila politikandi, evo phila kingudi kiandi, evo mu kibila kinkaka.

Ayi vala-sa-siwu luswasunu ko mu kibila ki tswasunu thadulu politika yi batu mu zitsi, evo mu kibila ki tswasunu mswa-nzitumunu yi batu-batu mu zitsi, voti mu kibila ki luswasunu lu mbutukulu evo lu khadulu mutu mu phila-phila tsi, yi kimpwanza, evo yintalu kuidi tsi mka, voti tsi ikoso mu tsi mka.

folded.id: evo|mu|mambu ma mikanda myandi minsweki
folded.subject: evo

spans.text: Kwisi-ko mutu wala tatusu mu luzingu lwandi luswama, evo mu mambu mandi ma tsi-nzo ayi mu mambu ma bukanda bwandi, evo mu mambu ma mikanda myandi minsweki, enati vasi kibila kitungu-ko.
Mu khotolo batu evo luyalu mu mambu ma ngana mansweki, woso mutu mswa ayi luve kadi kutanunu kwidi lutumu ayi mswa luyalu.

folded.subject: lu kubasika

spans.text: Woso mutu widi mswa ayi luve lu kubasika mu tsi-andi um kwenda ku tsi-mka, ayi um ku-bwe-vutuka ku tsi-andi.

folded.id: mandi moso|mu|yoso kwandi phila mbemo
folded.subject: mandi moso

folded.object: ngolo yi butinu bu mikaka nkinza bene luidi

folded.id: monoso|mu|procesu yi myalu-nguba
folded.subject: monoso

spans.text: Woso mutu umtatu mu mavanga mambi fwene kutwama bongolo dibungu dimbote, nate mbelo-andi immonoso mu procesu yi myalu-nguba, ayi mafwana moso ma butanunu bwandi mantulu-va-tsi.

folded.id: mosi batu|boso|ayi binvuka biluyalu bi zitsi zioso
folded.subject: mosi batu
folded.object: ayi binvuka biluyalu bi zitsi zioso

spans.text: MTINU-LUKUTUNGUNU Wunyamikisa NGYAMUKUSU YI MISWA MI MUTU emimi, dede lukanu lunsadulu kuidi zinvila ayi zitsi zioso, mosi batu boso ayi binvuka biluyalu bi zitsi zioso, bu ba-mi-tebukila monho, basia-ngolo mu-ku-mi-yiyisa mu zinzo-zinkanda, mu-ku-mi-tumina ayi mu-kwe-mi-yonzulanga mu mavanga ma basi tsi-awu ayi mu mavanga ma basi bandi-batu, bakhembo basi kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana.

folded.subject: na
folded.object: mbonosono luwiluku lwandi ayi mayindu mandi

spans.text: Woso mutu mswa ayi luve kadi ku kimpwanza ki mayindu, ki tsimtima ayi ki luwiluku; Mswa bewowo umvana luve kwidi woso mutu lu kubaluka mu luwiluku evo mu mayindu, na mu mbonosono luwiluku lwandi ayi mayindu mandi, va nafeka evo va mbo-yi-batu, nafeka voti na mbatzi-andi, mu zikhadulu, mu malongi evo mu tsambudulu ayi voti mu phila bipa.

folded.id: nguba|mu|kitezo kifwana kuidi nzo-mkanu yi songa
folded.subject: nguba
folded.object: kitezo kifwana kuidi nzo-mkanu yi songa

spans.text: Woso kwa mutu widi mswa, buka woso yandi mutu, mu kufundusu va myalu-nguba mu kitezo kifwana kuidi nzo-mkanu yi songa , inzenga mambu mu budede ayi mu bukiedika bu mavanga mandi, na miswa na buloko bwandi.

folded.id: tatu|mu|mavanga mambi fwene kutwama bongolo dibungu dimbote
folded.subject: tatu
folded.object: mavanga mambi fwene kutwama bongolo dibungu dimbote

spans.text: Woso mutu umtatu mu mavanga mambi fwene kutwama bongolo dibungu dimbote, nate mbelo-andi immonoso mu procesu yi myalu-nguba, ayi mafwana moso ma butanunu bwandi mantulu-va-tsi.

folded.id: ti batinu|boso|bangu kinvuka ki zitsi zibundana babundidi-thulu mu ngwakunu ayi myadi kinvuka ki zitsi zi bundana mu kusadila lukaku ayi thumunu yi miswa ayi yi maluve ma mutu ayi mvandi bumpwanza bungudi bu mutu
folded.subject: ti Batinu
folded.object: bangu kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana babundidi-thulu mu ngwakunu ayi MYadi kinvuka ki Zitsi zi Bundana mu kusadila lukaku ayi thumunu yi miswa ayi yi maluve ma mutu ayi mvandi bumpwanza bungudi bu mutu

spans.text: Mu kibila ti Batinu boso bangu kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana babundidi-thulu mu ngwakunu ayi MYadi kinvuka ki Zitsi zi Bundana mu kusadila lukaku ayi thumunu yi miswa ayi yi maluve ma mutu ayi mvandi bumpwanza bungudi bu mutu;

folded.id: tisu|mu|ngolo kukota mu kithwadi
folded.subject: tisu

spans.text: Kwisi-ko mutu mtisu mu ngolo kukota mu kithwadi.

folded.id: tsi ikoso|mu|tsi mka
folded.subject: tsi ikoso

spans.text: Ayi vala-sa-siwu luswasunu ko mu kibila ki tswasunu thadulu politika yi batu mu zitsi, evo mu kibila ki tswasunu mswa-nzitumunu yi batu-batu mu zitsi, voti mu kibila ki luswasunu lu mbutukulu evo lu khadulu mutu mu phila-phila tsi, yi kimpwanza, evo yintalu kuidi tsi mka, voti tsi ikoso mu tsi mka.

folded.id: veka evo|mu|mkangu
folded.subject: veka evo

spans.text: Woso mutu, na veka evo mu mkangu, luve ayi mswa kadi mu kuvwa yandi nzo evo yandi khadi.

folded.id: voti lutelo|mu|mavada masiwu ti mbivusu innene kwidi lutumu-mswa luntangununwanga ti "direito comum"
folded.subject: voti lutelo
folded.object: mavada masiwu ti mbivusu innene kwidi lutumu-mswa luntangununwanga ti "direito comum"

spans.text: Vangi mswa-bewowo wisi-ko ngolo voti lutelo mu mavada masiwu ti mbivusu innene kwidi lutumu-mswa luntangununwanga ti "direito comum", evo mu mavada mambi madi ndambi yi zikhanu zi mayindu ma kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana.

folded.id: voti|mu|kibila ki luswasunu lu mbutukulu evo lu khadulu mutu mu phila-phila tsi
folded.subject: voti
folded.object: kibila ki luswasunu lu mbutukulu evo lu khadulu mutu mu phila-phila tsi

spans.text: Ayi vala-sa-siwu luswasunu ko mu kibila ki tswasunu thadulu politika yi batu mu zitsi, evo mu kibila ki tswasunu mswa-nzitumunu yi batu-batu mu zitsi, voti mu kibila ki luswasunu lu mbutukulu evo lu khadulu mutu mu phila-phila tsi, yi kimpwanza, evo yintalu kuidi tsi mka, voti tsi ikoso mu tsi mka.

folded.id: wala siwu|mu|buvika
folded.subject: wala siwu

spans.text: Kwisi ko mutu wala siwu mu buvika; Buvika ayi phila mambu moso matedi buvika bikanduku.

folded.id: wala tatusu|mu|luzingu lwandi luswama
folded.subject: wala tatusu

spans.text: Kwisi-ko mutu wala tatusu mu luzingu lwandi luswama, evo mu mambu mandi ma tsi-nzo ayi mu mambu ma bukanda bwandi, evo mu mambu ma mikanda myandi minsweki, enati vasi kibila kitungu-ko.

folded.id: wala tulu|mu|thovokolo evo mu phasi zimakhemi
folded.subject: wala tulu

spans.text: Kwisi ko mutu wala tulu mu thovokolo evo mu phasi zimakhemi, zi-kunkitisa bumutu bwandi.

Kwisi mutu ko wala komo mu bumbedi mu mambu o ma-zimbukunu evo o ma-khembo sonama dede ti msiku mu thangu yi-ka-ma-sadila, evo mamkambu-ba ti ma mbedoso va thalu mswa-luyalu lu tsi-andi voti va thalu mswa-mtinu luyalu lu tsi-mvimba.

folded.id: yandi|mu|mtima bukhomba
folded.subject: yandi

spans.text: Bizingi-bene, batu, badi diela ayi tsi-ntima, bafwene kuzingila mbatzi-na-mbatzi-yandi mu mtima bukhomba.

folded.id: yiyisa|mu|zinzo-zinkanda
folded.subject: yiyisa

spans.text: MTINU-LUKUTUNGUNU Wunyamikisa NGYAMUKUSU YI MISWA MI MUTU emimi, dede lukanu lunsadulu kuidi zinvila ayi zitsi zioso, mosi batu boso ayi binvuka biluyalu bi zitsi zioso, bu ba-mi-tebukila monho, basia-ngolo mu-ku-mi-yiyisa mu zinzo-zinkanda, mu-ku-mi-tumina ayi mu-kwe-mi-yonzulanga mu mavanga ma basi tsi-awu ayi mu mavanga ma basi bandi-batu, bakhembo basi kinvuka ki Zitsi Zibundana.

folded.object: mavanga ma basi tsi-awu ayi mu mavanga ma basi bandi-batu
